chat_messages_scope_targets.value:
("chat_messages"."scope" = 'global' and "chat_messages"."room_id" is null and "chat_messages"."recipient_id" is null)

        or ("chat_messages"."scope" = 'private' and "chat_messages"."recipient_id" is not null)
